Read the following passage and answer the question by choosing the best option. Provide only the text of the correct option as your answer.

Passage: A million homes in Morocco could soon be powered by a mega solar plant capable of providing energy at all hours of the day and night. Instead of using the standard photovoltaic solar cells, Ouarzazate's power station will use Concentrated Solar Power (CSP) - a technology that harnesses sunlight to melt salt and power a steam turbine. The plant, called Noor1, is expected to open next month and will be the first of four stations to be set up in the region. Once complete, the establishment will be the largest CSP farm in the world. The Ouarzazate plant is part of Morocco's strategy to produce 42 per cent of its energy from renewable sources by 2020 - a goal that has been praised by the UN.
@highlight
The Ouarzazate plant will be the biggest solar thermal plant in the world
@highlight
It will use a technology known as Concentrate Solar Power (CSP)
@highlight
CSP harnesses sunlight to melt salt and power a steam turbine
@highlight
Morocco plans to get 42 per cent of its energy from renewables by 2020
Query: While solar thermal power methods such as @placeholder only work in very hot countries, solar energy at large is experiencing more widespread use worldwide as the photovoltaic panels' price is progressively falling.

Options : A. Ouarzazate
B. Concentrate Solar Power
C. Morocco
D. UN
E. Concentrated Solar Power
F. CSP
G. Noor1

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the contetn of the correct option.
